parts.text: Use only deterministic BARRED artifact tools. Summarize barred-fleet/tests/fixtures/adk_smoke_cloud/adk_smoke_attempts.jsonl, then run the B-gate on barred-fleet/tests/fixtures/adk_smoke_cloud/adk_smoke_corpus.jsonl with attempts_path barred-fleet/tests/fixtures/adk_smoke_cloud/adk_smoke_attempts.jsonl and min_verifier_parse_ok_rate 1.0. Report whether the gate passed, the accepted row count, verifier parse-ok rate, verifier pass rate, and explicitly say cassette replay is not provider-side cache telemetry.
The B-gate passed with 1 accepted row, verifier_parse_ok_rate 1.0, and verifier_pass_rate 1.0. Cassette replay is not provider-side cache telemetry.
